site.name: Hamburg Board Game Club
site.description: A board game club meeting every other Thursday in the Schanzenviertel. Members bring what is on their own shelf, the group picks what fits the table that night, and anyone who wants a game taught gets it taught. From twenty-minute fillers to the heavy stuff.

descriptions.de: Wir hatten den Hinterraum im Würfelwerk, haben zwei Tische aufgemacht und gespielt, was mitgebracht wurde. Die Zusagen hängen noch am Termin, damit man sieht, was wirklich auf dem Tisch lag.
descriptions.en: We took over the back room at Würfelwerk, split into two tables, and played what people had brought. The pledges are still on the event so anyone can see what actually hit the table.

teasers.de: Beim letzten Mal: zwei Tische, ein Legespiel, das ausuferte, und ein Absacker ohne Ende.
teasers.en: Last time out: two tables, a tile game that ran long, and a filler that would not end.

descriptions.de: Einlass 19:00 Uhr im Würfelwerk. Sag aus deinem Regal zu, damit niemand ein doppeltes Spiel durch die Stadt schleppt, und vergleiche die Spielerzahlen mit der Teilnehmerzahl, bevor du packst.
descriptions.en: Doors at 19:00 at Würfelwerk. Pledge from your shelf so nobody carries a duplicate across town, and check the player counts against the headcount before you pack.

json.title: Bring what is on your shelf
Bring mit, was in deinem Regal steht
How the night works
json.content: Every other Thursday we take the back room at Würfelwerk. Members keep their own shelf here, say beforehand what they are bringing, and the player counts are checked against the headcount before anyone packs a box. Nobody carries three copies of the same game across town again.

json.title: So läuft der Abend
json.content: Alle zwei Wochen donnerstags haben wir den Hinterraum im Würfelwerk. Mitglieder pflegen hier ihr eigenes Regal, sagen vorher zu, was sie mitbringen, und die Spielerzahlen werden mit der Teilnehmerzahl abgeglichen, bevor jemand eine Schachtel einpackt. Nie wieder drei Exemplare desselben Spiels quer durch die Stadt.

json.title: Ask for a title
json.content: The catalog shows who owns what and who is happy to teach it. If a game you want played is on somebody else's shelf, ask them to bring it - the request lands in their notifications and they accept or decline in one click. New players are welcome; there is always someone teaching a first round.

json.title: Nach einem Titel fragen
json.content: Im Katalog steht, wem was gehört und wer es gerne erklärt. Steht ein Spiel, das du spielen willst, in einem fremden Regal, frag einfach danach - die Anfrage landet in den Benachrichtigungen und wird mit einem Klick angenommen oder abgelehnt. Neue Leute sind willkommen, eine Erklärrunde findet sich immer.

rows.name: Catan
rows.description: Settlers trade and build on an island whose resources never quite line up.

rows.name: Carcassonne
rows.description: Players lay tiles to build a medieval landscape and claim its features.

rows.name: Ticket to Ride
rows.description: Collect train cards and claim railway routes across a continent.

rows.name: Pandemic
rows.description: A team of specialists races four diseases around the world.

rows.name: 7 Wonders
rows.description: Three ages of card drafting build a wonder of the ancient world.

rows.name: Dominion
rows.description: Every player builds a deck from a shared supply of kingdom cards.

rows.name: Azul
rows.description: Tile drafting for the walls of the Royal Palace of Evora.

rows.name: Wingspan
rows.description: A bird collection engine builder set in forest, grassland and wetland.

rows.name: Codenames
rows.description: Two spymasters give one-word clues to contact their agents first.

rows.name: Halma
rows.description: Pieces hop across the board in chains to reach the opposite camp first.

rows.name: Crokinole
rows.description: Wooden discs are flicked at the centre hole past a ring of pegs.

rows.name: Scythe
rows.description: Five factions compete for a war-torn 1920s Eastern Europe.

rows.name: Terraforming Mars
rows.description: Corporations raise the temperature, oxygen and oceans of Mars.

rows.name: Agricola
rows.description: A farming family expands its house, fields and pastures.

rows.name: Everdell
rows.description: Woodland critters build a city of cards through the four seasons.

rows.name: The Werewolves of Millers Hollow
rows.description: The village votes someone out each morning while the werewolves hunt each night.

rows.name: Just One
rows.description: Everyone writes a one-word clue, and matching clues cancel out.

rows.name: Backgammon
rows.description: Two players race their fifteen checkers home across twenty-four points.

rows.name: Hive
rows.description: Insect tiles surround the opposing queen bee on an open board.

rows.name: Spirit Island
rows.description: Island spirits push back colonial invaders before the island is spoiled.
